body.objective: Close Phase 1 with an exact viability classification—either a scoped architectural classification ending or selection of one robust changed-theory candidate for Phase 2—without requiring a complete quantum-gravity theory.
body.stop_condition: Import by exact hashes the complete counterflow robust all-isotype health verdict, the terminal action-specific nonlinear q2/charge disposition, the terminal regraded observer physical-descent/frequency-ratio disposition, the Phase 1 quantum synthesis and the programme-wide bidirectional paper-coverage baseline. Verify that every dependency refers to the same selected action/background/charge carrier where it makes a candidate claim, and type nonactivation rather than combining incompatible laboratories. Freeze exactly one of two records. CLASSIFICATION ENDING: no stationary retuning preserves the causal parent, dressed-trace removal and robust complete physical stability; record the exact causal construction, instability/no-go, nonlinear obstruction structure, observer disposition and strict-Weyl quantum obstruction, without opening another action architecture. CANDIDATE-SELECTION ENDING: an open or structurally protected stationary locus preserves the full causal contraction and complete unary health, has a defined invariant q2/charge-sector disposition and at least one admissible relational observable; select it for Phase 2 while stating that no complete quantum theory, particles, scattering or unitarity follows. In either ending, reverse-audit Papers 00, 09--14, 90--92, 98 and 99 against current certificates and typed lifecycle boundaries, create scoped correction items for every remaining material mismatch, verify the atlas and public graphs, and emit a Phase 1 claims ledger, dependency snapshot, paper-coverage report and human-readable closure report. Black-hole endpoint and third-order Kuranishi companion papers must be current and publishably scoped but are not allowed to delay the core closure if their existing theorems remain honest.
body.forbid: no viable theory required for closure; no causal parent called physically stable; no isolated collision called a selected locus; no undefined q2 or observer imported as a pass; no strict/compensator/counterflow theory conflation; no overview-only mention counted as technical paper coverage; no black-hole or Kuranishi companion gate used to postpone core closure indefinitely; no new architecture, particle, scattering, unitarity or complete-quantum-gravity claim
activates: Phase 2 development of a selected robust candidate
or a publication-complete Phase 1 classification/no-go endpoint
body.resource_hint: FINAL PHASE 1 JOIN. Outcome-independent: a well-supported no-go/classification and a robust candidate selection are equally valid endings. Do not reconstruct missing science in this item; branch on the terminal producer evidence and author scoped correction work where necessary.
